name: FPV Dive
blurb: A drone dives in and banks past.

shots.action: Wind ripples the brush by the road as the scene rushes closer.
shots.sound: Buzzing drone propellers and rushing wind.
shots.cameraText: The FPV drone camera starts high above, tips forward, dives fast toward the subject, banks hard and pulls up past them
shots.framing: a low tracking shot beside the subject
